text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to run the payments.user_email schema change + backfill this Saturday 2026-03-28 02:00–04:00 UTC. Need deploy owner, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. We expect 3 backfill slices; want to stagger to avoid DB spikes. Also need CDC pause plan and dual-write window. @jordan @alex can you confirm?

alex: I can own the deploy and be on-call for that window. I will run the smoke script and watch the canary traffic. Link to ops runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/payments-email-migration (steps 1–7).

sanjay: I'll own the backfill jobs. Plan: 3 slices, each ~40–50m. Start times 02:05 / 02:55 / 03:45 UTC. This spaces peak writes and keeps DB connections stable. I'll tune chunk_size to 10k rows.

kate: Quick checklist: ensure feature-flag gate for new column, cache flush for reader-service after rollout, and metric alerts for duplicate-email rate. Also add a kill-switch flag for the backfill job.

ops-bot: change-window request #CW-2026-153 approved by change-schedule. Reminder: schedule the preflight smoke 30m prior and upload migration artifacts to /ops/migrations/3411112223/.

jordan: DB team: we'll supervise the schema change. The online index add will use pt-online-schema-change wrapper; expect a short metadata lock < 10s but the copy phase runs in background. We'll be present for the slot.

db-admin: Confirmed. For the unique index add we recommend a short dual-write window of 10 minutes where writes go to both schemas until verification. We'll also snapshot the table before change: /backups/payments_email_pre_3411112223.sql.gz.

maria: Alex — can you capture the smoke script output here after the preflight? Need first 10 lines and exit code. Also where will rollback artifact live?

alex: Smoke script is in the repo. Quick preflight command:

```bash
./ops/smoke/migration_smoke.sh --env prod --migration payments.user_email --timeout 120
# sample output
STARTING SMOKE: payments.user_email
check-db-conn: ok
check-cdc-stream: ok
check-canary-service: ok
verify-schema-backup: ok
verify-health-endpoints: ok
lint-queries: ok
run-test-inserts: ok
END SMOKE: SUCCESS (0)
```

Rollback artifact: /ops/migrations/rollbacks/payments_email_rollback_3411112223.sql.gz (will be uploaded by me after preflight).

kate: If anything looks off during slice 2, we should abort remaining slices and initiate rollback. Add that to the runbook run-step list.

maria: Sounds good. Action items: alex (deploy + smoke + upload rollback), sanjay (backfill slices scheduled + chunk tuning), jordan/db-admin (schema change + dual-write guard), kate (feature-flag + cache flush + alerts). Please react :thumbsup: when you have these captured. I'll post final runbook link and ETA by EOD Friday.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll post the preflight log here after 01:30 UTC Sat.

sanjay: :thumbsup: slicing jobs created and tuned.

jordan: :thumbsup: DB on standby.

db-admin: :thumbsup: taking backup tonight at 23:45 UTC.
